text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Trainer, there's something I gotta talk to you about.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Looking at that gentle smile—I understood.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The end has finally come," I think to myself,
as I am led toward the nighttime shore.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Those fun days. I wish they could have lasted longer.
But...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I didn't feel it was too tragic of an ending.
After all, Wonder Acute is an Umamusume who accomplished her goal.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Trainer. You see, what I wanted to talk about is...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Would you watch my run?
A run with everything I've got.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Yes...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: At the very end, huh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Saying that, Wonder Acute began to run with all her might.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Ohoooooo!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
(Trainer, thank you so much.
Thank you...)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
(Burn this into your memory.
This run of mine...)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
(This is what Trainer taught me...
my... my very own...)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Horyaaaaaaaaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her running was solid and skillful—
yet it still seemed to harbor a youthful vigor.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's so heartbreakingly close.
Yet, there's no more firewood left to stoke my heart's flame.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Neither the opera's singing, the falcon's cry, nor my reach as a Trainer can reach them anymore.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We can only watch her pull away... That's all we can do...
Is this... our limit...?!
Taaaaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right then, kicking up sand with great force—
someone leaped onto the beach.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Closing in furiously on Wonder Acute at tremendous speed,
she pulls right alongside her!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh? Running side-by-side with me...
You're...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Running without backing down an inch against Wonder Acute. That Umamusume was—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: There was no mistaking it. That figure, which had grown even more robust, was—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Pardon me, all of a sudden.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having entered the Classic year, she was a rising dirt star
who had even placed in the Japan Dirt Derby.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Tarumae-chan, why...?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Sorry to keep you waiting, Acute-san.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Face me in a match!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: A match, you say... Tarumae-chan...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
No way!
You weren't waiting for me, were you?!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Um... Ah... No...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"To be honest, I wasn't waiting.
I was constantly walking a tightrope, staking my entire career on the line—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There was no time to worry about the junior Umamusume.
However...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I've finally made it.
To the point where I can run alongside my respected dirt seniors.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
As a local idol born in Tomakomai,
reaching a level where I can compete with my idol inspirations, Falco-san and Acute-san.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: So that's fine by you, right, Acute-san?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
You'll compete with me, won't you?
—This autumn.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Even if you say that, Tarumae-chan...
That sort of thing is for Falco-san to...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Falco-san can barely enter races right now, right?
Ever since her overseas expedition, she's been putting
a lot of effort into her new activities abroad.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: “Well, as for me... um... how do I put this...”

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Then instead of a match, why don't I
tell you a story about Falco-san?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"A vivid story that only I,
who ran right beside them, can tell."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: With all due respect, Acute-san.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: I believe that the only place... you can hear stories with real life in them is the racetrack.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Tarumae-chan...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yes, just like that day...
when Acute-san and Falco-san
spoke to me with such passion.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I will never forget. That Tokyo Daishoten,
and the Kawasaki Kinen that followed—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
The eye-opening race
that Falco-san and Acute-san showed us...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Back then... I was constantly in a slump.
Neither my racing nor my local idol work was going well at all.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I was brooding over "why?"
But after seeing that race, I finally understand!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I don't desire that brilliance enough.
Even if my efforts are plain, if I stack them up dozens, dozens of times, I'll reach it someday!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I've always looked up to Falco-san!
But the one who showed me what I was lacking most
in that Kawasaki Kinen was...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...It's Acute-san.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Tarumae-chan...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I want to know. The strength
that your running possesses.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Clashing at full force, feeling it like a crashing tidal wave, and then—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I want to grow much, much bigger!
For Tomakomai's sake!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae knew nothing about the situation here. Nothing about being on the verge of retirement.
Even so...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"That was precisely why her words held such strength.
The strength of someone who hadn't the slightest doubt her challenge would be accepted."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She believed that instincts would respond to—instincts.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Am I still no match for you?
Perhaps that's true. But—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"I'd like you to see for yourself in a race
whether I'm truly no match for you."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Please show me through your running.
Every single part of who you are.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Tarumae...-chan...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I've found it.
The thing I searched and searched for, but could never findâ

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Kindling." The kindling of life that somehow kept the dying embers burning.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“The dirt Umamusume with long racing careers
have kept this flame alive, passing it down without fail—”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The sand—we have kept it burning.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Tarumae-chan... in that case...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"I guess I'll run just once.
Only once, mind you."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"If you're really serious about wanting
to feel everything I've got..."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Care to come? The JBC Classic.
I might just play around with you for a bit there.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Yes! I'd love that, please!!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well, if you put it that way, how can I refuse?
I'm counting on you too, Trainer~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, a promise was made. Somehow, hope remained connected.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It barely arrived in time.
The passion of the new generation,
which has inspired so many of their seniors...
